name: Zizaniopsis
look_here_first: GIANT CUTGRASS: native emergent warm-season rhizomatous wetland grass with tall reedlike jointed leafy stems, broad rough/sharp blades, and a tall open branching inflorescence rather than Phragmites' feathery plume. Confirm a separate male/female spikelet structure with magnification and true leaf collar; do not identify by wet habitat or blade sharpness alone.
